summary: Brookfield Asset Management, via its flagship private equity strategy, agreed on September 15, 2026 to acquire 100% of ASX-listed Reliance Worldwide Corporation (RWC), a global plumbing and heating solutions manufacturer, for all cash. The proposal of US$3.38 per share values Reliance at enterprise value of roughly US$2.8 billion. The Reliance Board unanimously recommended the all-cash offer to shareholders, who will vote on the agreement. The transaction supports Reliance's next phase of growth, with Brookfield citing global industrial operating expertise and US housing ecosystem exposure. Deal mechanics and regulatory timetable are not disclosed in the excerpt. Watch shareholder vote outcome, ASX scheme timetable, regulatory clearances and any competing bid emergence.
